name: 10 Best Spider-Man (Peter Parker) Comics Reading List
description: Ten Peter Parker selections, from the Lee-Ditko origins to Life Story. Includes the Lee-Romita opening chapters, Hobgoblin, Jean DeWolff, Kraven's Last Hunt, Harry Osborn, Coming Home, the Gauntlet and Superior Spider-Man. Optional preludes: Amazing Spider-Man #600, #606 and #611 before the Gauntlet, and Big Time #648-652 before Dying Wish. Compiled from the owner's exact outline of Comic Book Herald's guide.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
